description.en:
Basic Attack

Baizhi instructs You'tan to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG.

Heavy Attack

Baizhi continuously consumes STA to command You'tan to attack enemies, dealing Glacio DMG. During Heavy Attack, Baizhi can command You'tan to move.

Mid-air Attack

Baizhi consumes STA and summons You'tan in mid-air to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Baizhi memerintahkan You'tan untuk melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Glacio DMG.

Heavy Attack

Baizhi terus-menerus mengonsumsi STA untuk memerintahkan You'tan menyerang musuh, memberikan Glacio DMG. Selama Heavy Attack, Baizhi dapat memerintahkan You'tan untuk bergerak.

Mid-air Attack

Baizhi mengonsumsi STA dan memanggil You'tan di udara untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG.

description.en: Baizhi calls You'tan to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG while immediately healing all characters on nearby teams.
description.id: Baizhi memanggil You'tan untuk menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG sekaligus langsung menyembuhkan seluruh karakter di tim sekitar.

description.en:
Baizhi summons You'tan to heal all characters on nearby teams, generating 4 stacks of Remnant Entities.

Remnant Entities

Remnant Entities follow the active team members. 1 stack(s) of Remnant Entities are automatically consumed to perform Coordinated Attacks every 2.5s, dealing Glacio DMG on hit while healing all characters of the team when the active character is within the range.
description.id:
Baizhi memanggil You'tan untuk menyembuhkan seluruh karakter di tim sekitar, menghasilkan 4 stack Remnant Entities.

Remnant Entities

Remnant Entities mengikuti anggota tim yang aktif. 1 stack Remnant Entities otomatis dikonsumsi untuk melakukan Coordinated Attack setiap 2,5 dtk, memberikan Glacio DMG saat mengenai target sekaligus menyembuhkan seluruh karakter tim ketika karakter aktif berada dalam jangkauan.

description.en:
When Baizhi casts Resonance Skill Emergency Plan, You'tan generates a field of Euphonia that lasts for 15s.

Euphonia

ATK of the Resonators who pick up Euphonia is increased by 15% for 20s.
description.id:
Saat Baizhi melancarkan Resonance Skill Emergency Plan, You'tan menghasilkan area Euphonia yang bertahan selama 15 dtk.

Euphonia

ATK Resonator yang mengambil Euphonia meningkat sebesar 15% selama 20 dtk.

description.en: Baizhi's Heavy Attack on hit heals the character with the lowest HP on a nearby team by 0.25% of her Max HP.
description.id: Heavy Attack Baizhi yang mengenai target menyembuhkan karakter dengan HP terendah di tim sekitar sebesar 0,25% dari Max HP miliknya.

description.en: Baizhi calls You'tan to perform 1 plunging attack, dealing Glacio DMG while healing all characters on a nearby team.
description.id: Baizhi memanggil You'tan untuk melakukan 1 plunging attack, memberikan Glacio DMG sekaligus menyembuhkan seluruh karakter di tim sekitar.

description.en:
You'tan

A Remnant Creature that answers to Baizhi's mind and desires while sharing all her stats. You'tan goes back to Baizhi when Baizhi dodges.

Concentration

Baizhi consumes all "Concentration" when casting Heavy Attack or Resonance Skill Emergency Plan to continuously heal all Resonators on nearby teams. Each 1 "Concentration" consumed provides 1 healing. The healing happens every 2s.
When Baizhi consumes "Concentration" to cast Heavy Attack, Baizhi additionally restores Concerto Energy and Resonance Energy.
When Baizhi consumes "Concentration" to cast Resonance Skill Emergency Plan, Baizhi additionally restores Concerto Energy.

Forte Gauge: Concentration

Baizhi can hold up to 4 "Concentration".
Baizhi obtains 1 "Concentration" for every Basic Attack on hit.
description.id:
You'tan

Remnant Creature yang menuruti pikiran dan keinginan Baizhi sekaligus berbagi seluruh stat miliknya. You'tan kembali ke Baizhi saat Baizhi melakukan Dodge.

Concentration

Baizhi mengonsumsi seluruh "Concentration" saat melancarkan Heavy Attack atau Resonance Skill Emergency Plan untuk menyembuhkan seluruh Resonator di tim sekitar secara berkelanjutan. Setiap 1 "Concentration" yang dikonsumsi memberikan 1 penyembuhan. Penyembuhan terjadi setiap 2 dtk.
Saat Baizhi mengonsumsi "Concentration" untuk melancarkan Heavy Attack, Baizhi juga memulihkan Concerto Energy dan Resonance Energy.
Saat Baizhi mengonsumsi "Concentration" untuk melancarkan Resonance Skill Emergency Plan, Baizhi juga memulihkan Concerto Energy.

Forte Gauge: Concentration

Baizhi dapat menyimpan hingga 4 "Concentration".
Baizhi memperoleh 1 "Concentration" untuk setiap Basic Attack yang mengenai target.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: Heal the incoming Resonator by 1.54% of Baizhi's max HP every 3s for 30s. The healed Resonator has their DMG Amplified by 15% for 6s.
description.id: Menyembuhkan Resonator yang masuk sebesar 1,54% dari Max HP Baizhi setiap 3 dtk selama 30 dtk. Resonator yang disembuhkan mendapat Amplify DMG sebesar 15% selama 6 dtk.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: Resonance Skill Emergency Plan additionally restores 2.5 Resonance Energy for every 1 Concentration consumed.
description.id: Resonance Skill Emergency Plan juga memulihkan 2,5 Resonance Energy untuk setiap 1 Concentration yang dikonsumsi.

description.en: Resonance Skill Emergency Plan increases Baizhi's Glacio DMG Bonus by 15% and her Healing by 15% if she has 4 Concentration. These effects last for 12s.
description.id: Resonance Skill Emergency Plan meningkatkan Glacio DMG Bonus Baizhi sebesar 15% dan Healing miliknya sebesar 15% jika ia memiliki 4 Concentration. Efek ini bertahan selama 12 dtk.

description.en: Intro Skill Overflowing Frost increases Baizhi's Max HP by 12% for 10s.
description.id: Intro Skill Overflowing Frost meningkatkan Max HP Baizhi sebesar 12% selama 10 dtk.

description.en: If a team member is knocked out when Baizhi is alive on the team, immediately revive them and restore 100% of their Max HP. This effect can be triggered once every 10 minute(s).
description.id: Jika anggota tim tumbang saat Baizhi masih hidup di dalam tim, langsung bangkitkan mereka dan pulihkan 100% Max HP mereka. Efek ini dapat aktif sekali setiap 10 menit.

description.en: When Euphonia is picked up, increase the Glacio DMG Bonus of all characters nearby by 12% for 20s.
description.id: Saat Euphonia diambil, tingkatkan Glacio DMG Bonus seluruh karakter di sekitar sebesar 12% selama 20 dtk.
